1.web: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
1.asv: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? Why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

2.web: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance; Mount Zion, in which you have lived.
2.asv: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast gotten of old, Which thou hast redeemed to be the tribe of thine inheritance; Andmount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

3.web: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.
3.asv: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual ruins, All the evil that the enemy hath done in the sanctuary.

4.web: Your adversaries have roared in the midst of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.
4.asv: Thine adversaries have roared in the midst of thine assembly; They have set up their ensigns for signs.

5.web: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.
5.asv: They seemed as men that lifted up Axes upon a thicket of trees.

6.web: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
6.asv: And now all the carved work thereof They break down with hatchet and hammers.

7.web: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.
7.asv: They have set thy sanctuary on fire; They have profaned the dwelling-place of thy name by casting it to the ground.

8.web: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.
8.asv: They said in their heart, Let us make havoc of them altogether: They have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

9.web: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
9.asv: We see not our signs: There is no more any prophet; Neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

10.web: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
10.asv: How long, O God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

11.web: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it out of your pocket and consume them!
11.asv: Why drawest thou back thy hand, even thy right hand? Pluck itout of thy bosom and consume them.

12.web: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
12.asv: Yet God is my King of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth.

13.web: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
13.asv: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: Thou brakest the heads of the sea-monsters in the waters.

14.web: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
14.asv: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces; Thou gavest him to be food to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

15.web: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
15.asv: Thou didst cleave fountain and flood: Thou driedst up mighty rivers.

16.web: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.
16.asv: The day is thine, the night also is thine: Thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

17.web: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.
17.asv: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: Thou hast made summer and winter.

18.web: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.
18.asv: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Jehovah, And that a foolish people hath blasphemed thy name.

19.web: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.
19.asv: Oh deliver not the soul of thy turtle-dove unto the wild beast: Forget not the life of thy poor for ever.

20.web: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.
20.asv: Have respect unto the covenant; For the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of violence.

21.web: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.
21.asv: Oh let not the oppressed return ashamed: Let the poor and needy praise thy name.

22.web: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.
22.asv: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: Remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee all the day.

23.web: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.
23.asv: Forget not the voice of thine adversaries: The tumult of those that rise up against thee ascendeth continually.
